item.title: Users may experience issues logging into Playvox [resolved]
item.description:
Our cloud provider has confirmed a full recovery of the service. We have continued monitoring and can confirm that Playvox services are operating normally at this time.
This incident is now considered resolved. If you experience any further issues, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
